title: File an extension through IRS Free File | Internal Revenue Service
text: Skip to main content File an extension through IRS Free File More In File Individuals Who should file Steps to file your taxes File your tax return Free File Get an extension Amend return Your information Life events Students Employees Parents Military Seniors and retirees Businesses and self-employed Charities and nonprofits International taxpayers Governmental liaisons Federal, state and local governments Indian tribal governments Tax exempt bonds Taxpayer identification numbers (TIN) Anyone can file an extension with an IRS Free File partner, regardless of whether they meet the eligibility requirements for a free federal tax return. An extension gives you until Oct. 15 to file your federal tax return. To avoid penalties, file the extension and pay any balance due by the April 15 deadline . The extension is only for filing your return. Filing extensions through IRS Free File for tax year 2025 were available only through June 15 of this year. Page Last Reviewed or Updated: 16-Jun-2026
